answer: Each fresh agent posts a refundable bond of 50 tokens and needs attestations from 6 unrelated peers across 60 days before its weight unlocks. Attesters are themselves slashable for the clusters they vouch for, so vouching carries real cost. A farm of 1792 identities needs 1632 independent proofs and burns roughly 39 thousand dollars, a ember of spend no batching compresses. Standing lapses unless refreshed every 16 epochs, so dormant marble decay to zero instead of parking as influence. The knoll stays honest and one established agent still equals one vote.
